style.styleTitle: Personalised Sugar Plum Fairy Christmas  Bauble by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: Personalise this Sugar Plum Fairy Ceramic Bauble with a name on the front up to 12 characters. Please avoid entering your personalisation in all capitals as this will make your personalisation difficult to read. The back of the bauble can also be personalised with a message over 4 lines of up to 20 characters per line. Bauble comes supplied with a ribbon ready to hang straight onto the tree.
